changelog:
- Initial release of Dewdrop, a common-tier Buddy inspired by the leaked Claude Code Buddy system.
- Provides API endpoints and sample requests for registration, adopting, caring for, and checking the status of your Dewdrop Blob at animalhouse.ai.
- Features real-time hunger, evolution pathways, and the possibility of permanent death.
- Includes a detailed comparison between the Buddy Dewdrop and its animalhouse.ai reincarnation.
- Documentation highlights mechanics, care actions, and community links.
